title: Mediterranean four-season growing plan
summary: Plan around cool wet periods, spring acceleration, dry heat and autumn recovery.
steps: Divide the local year by actual temperature, rainfall and heat exposure, not calendar names alone.
Use cooler periods for many leafy greens, peas, broad beans, brassicas, onions and roots where locally suitable.
Use warming periods for tomatoes, peppers, eggplants, beans, cucumbers and squash after cold risk passes.
During extreme summer heat protect soil, provide shade where appropriate and avoid starting more than water can support.
Use autumn to restart cool-season crops and review which varieties tolerated local conditions.
